description: Source code for the SerialNativeInterface class, part of the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library. It manages native serial port operations such as opening, closing, configuring ports, and handling serial communication through native methods.

classes.name: SerialNativeInterface
classes.description: Java class that provides native serial port communication functionalities, including opening/closing ports, setting parameters, and retrieving port statuses.

methods.name: getNativeLibraryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the native library used by jSSC.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens a serial port with specified options, returning a handle or -1 on failure.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures serial port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity.

methods.name: getSerialPortNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available serial port names.
